note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Windows PowerShell 5.1 on CON-SRV02. The LAPS schema extension is irreversible (acceptable in the disposable lab) and is not undone in teardown.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep08 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { $dn = (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName; if (-not (Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter "Name -eq 'LabServers'")) { New-ADOrganizationalUnit -Name LabServers -Path $dn }; foreach ($n in "CON-SRV01", "CON-SQL01", "CON-CLI01") { Get-ADComputer $n | Move-ADObject -TargetPath "OU=LabServers,$dn" } }

screens.name: laps-result
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-SRV01 { Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-LAPS/Operational' -MaxEvents 5 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -Wrap }

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { $dn = (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName; Remove-GPLink -Name "MGLab - Windows LAPS" -Target "OU=LabServers,$dn" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-GPO -Name "MGLab - Windows LAPS" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($n in "CON-SRV01", "CON-SQL01", "CON-CLI01") { Get-ADComputer $n | Move-ADObject -TargetPath "CN=Computers,$dn" }; Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Identity "OU=LabServers,$dn" | Set-ADObject -ProtectedFromAccidentalDeletion $false; Remove-ADOrganizationalUnit -Identity "OU=LabServers,$dn" -Recursive -Confirm:$false; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep08 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# the LAPS schema extension stays (irreversible); a rebuilt lab with Start-MGLab.ps1 starts clean. Passwords written by LAPS stay on the computer objects until the lab is rebuilt (lab-only data)
